boards.title: Your First Weekend at St Bonaventure University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-key, on-campus sequence for getting oriented through food, study, art, recreation, campus history and reflection.

cards.title: Start with a meal at Hickey
cards.subtitle: Friday arrival · Magnano Center
cards.notes: Use your meal plan or check the current menu before heading in. Hickey is near the main-campus residence halls, so it is a simple first meeting point.
cards.short_summary: Begin the weekend with a practical campus meal stop.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Bonaventure identifies Hickey Dining Hall as an on-campus dining location near the main-campus residence halls.
cards.access_notes: Dining is operated through university dining services; check current meal-plan eligibility, menus and service times before visiting.

cards.title: Find your bearings in Friedsam
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Campus library
cards.notes: Walk through the library and save its help channels for later. Ask at the desk or use the library’s online reference chat when a class question comes up.
cards.short_summary: Make the campus library a familiar anchor early on.
cards.evidence_claim: Friedsam Memorial Library is St. Bonaventure's primary campus repository for recorded information and provides research assistance.
cards.access_notes: Library access and building hours vary by academic period; confirm the current schedule on the library page.

cards.title: Spot the campus archives
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Lower level of Friedsam Library
cards.notes: Locate the archives while you are in Friedsam, then return when you have a course or personal-history question that calls for original campus materials.
cards.short_summary: Add a research resource and campus-history stop to your mental map.
cards.evidence_claim: The university archives documents St. Bonaventure history and is located on the lowest level of Friedsam Library.
cards.access_notes: Consult the archives page or contact the archivist before a research visit; hours and appointment practices may change.

cards.entity_name: Regina A. Quick Center for the Arts
cards.title: See what is showing at the Quick Center
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Quick Center galleries
cards.notes: Walk the galleries and look at the current installation labels. If you want more context, use the center’s exhibition information before planning a return visit.
cards.short_summary: A no-admission art stop in the middle of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Quick Center’s galleries display the university art collection and rotating installations, and are open to the public year-round at no charge.
cards.source_title: Regina A. Quick Center for the Arts | St. Bonaventure University
cards.access_notes: Gallery hours vary by season and university events; the Quick Center posts current hours and exhibition details.

cards.title: Pause at the University Chapel
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · Doyle Hall
cards.notes: Take a quiet look at the chapel’s stained-glass windows, or attend a listed service if that fits your practice. Keep the space respectful for worshippers.
cards.short_summary: A reflective campus stop with documented Franciscan imagery.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Chapel in Doyle Hall hosts Sunday Masses, and its six stained-glass windows depict aspects of Saint Bonaventure’s life and writings.
cards.access_notes: Worship schedules are published by University Ministries; visitors should follow posted chapel guidance.

cards.title: Look up at Our Lady’s Campanile
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · Beside the University Chapel
cards.notes: Pair this outdoor landmark with the chapel stop. Read its campus-history page first to understand the three bronze bells and their dedications.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor bell-tower landmark beside Doyle Chapel.
cards.evidence_claim: Our Lady’s Campanile stands next to the University Chapel and houses three bronze bells dedicated to Mary, Saint Francis and Saint Bonaventure.
cards.source_title: Campanile of Our Lady | St. Bonaventure University Archives
cards.access_notes: View the exterior from campus walkways; do not assume tower access.

cards.entity_name: Sandra A. and William L. Richter Center
cards.title: Move around at the Richter Center
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Campus recreation
cards.notes: Bring student identification and choose one available option, such as the walking track or courts. Check the posted schedule before making it your afternoon plan.
cards.short_summary: A campus recreation stop with courts, track and fitness equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: The Richter Center has basketball courts, an indoor walking/running track, racquetball courts, weight and cardio equipment, and recreation programming.
cards.access_notes: The university lists weekend hours, but schedules can change for holidays and breaks; verify before going.

cards.title: Get oriented at the Reilly Center
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Athletics and student center
cards.notes: Walk the building’s public corridors and check university listings for an upcoming campus event. Keep this as an orientation stop rather than assuming a game is scheduled.
cards.short_summary: A multipurpose campus center and home base for Bonnies athletics.
cards.evidence_claim: The Reilly Center is home to St. Bonaventure’s basketball and swim teams and other sports.
cards.source_title: Reilly Center | St. Bonaventure University Archives
cards.access_notes: Building and event access can differ by activity; consult current university event information before attending.

cards.title: Recognize Bob Lanier Court
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Inside the Reilly Center
cards.notes: When the arena is open for an approved event, notice the named court and its place in the athletics complex. Follow event entry and seating instructions.
cards.short_summary: A named court within the Reilly Center’s athletics setting.
cards.evidence_claim: University residence-life information identifies the Reilly Center as the place where the Bonnies play on Bob Lanier Court.
cards.source_title: Robinson & Falconio Halls | St. Bonaventure University
cards.access_notes: Court access is event-dependent; do not enter restricted athletics areas.

cards.title: Close outdoors at Marchiori Pavilion
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon · Near Devereux Hall
cards.notes: Meet outside for a daytime check-in and use the pavilion as a landmark on your next walk across campus. Follow all university and residence-life rules for the area.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor gathering landmark near the academic quad and Devereux Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Bonaventure identifies Marchiori Pavilion as an outdoor gathering spot near Devereux Hall with seating, fire pits and a grill.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor amenities are subject to campus rules, weather and any residence-life restrictions.
